# Paychex

> Paychex is a comprehensive HCM and payroll solutions provider offering integrated software, benefits administration, and HR services for businesses of all sizes.

Paychex delivers unified human capital management (HCM) through its Paychex Flex platform, serving accountants, small businesses, franchises, and enterprise clients. The company recently acquired Paycor to expand its HCM innovation capabilities and integrates AI-powered features like Recruiting Co-Pilot and Retention Insights.

## Key Topics

- Paychex Flex
- HCM (Human Capital Management)
